output.review_comment: The implementation correctly makes all tests pass, but has a critical documentation issue. The docstring describes pure graduated pricing, but the code implements volume pricing once the quantity reaches the final tier. This contradiction must be resolved by updating the docstring to accurately describe the actual behavior (graduated pricing for early tiers, then volume pricing for the final open-ended tier). The volume pricing logic itself is correct per the test spec, but it contradicts the docstring and needs to be explicitly documented for future maintainability. Additionally, clarify in comments exactly which behavior applies when.
